steps.title: Project foundation
steps.summary: Godot project, pixel display, controls, menu, language switch, data IDs.
steps.acceptance: Launch, enter and exit on Windows; switch Chinese/English; pixel display stays crisp.
evidence: Godot 4.7.2 editor import and runtime exited successfully
game/tests/m1_smoke.gd: M1_SMOKE_OK (Chinese/English, scene entry/return, movement, sprite)

steps.title: World map and exploration
steps.summary: Three destinations, top-down movement, NPCs, visible avoidable enemies.
steps.acceptance: Reach and leave all three locations without developer tools; bypass one normal fight.
evidence: game/tests/m2_smoke.gd: M2_SMOKE_OK (three destinations, map/area return, movement, NPC interaction, bypass, contact, enemy reset)

steps.title: Combat core
steps.summary: Flat side-view arena, actions, energy, enemy types, post-battle recovery.
steps.acceptance: Win or lose a contact battle; no jump; verify 20%/10% recovery and repeat encounters.
evidence: game/tests/m3_smoke.gd: M3_SMOKE_OK (two fixed enemy types, movement, attack, dodge, guard, energy, recovery, victory return, defeat menu)
Encounter transition measured 1–170 ms during automated checks on this development machine

steps.title: Companions and AI
steps.summary: Five slots, three recruit routes, level matching, switching, AI, pause commands.
steps.acceptance: All three remain recruitable; four-person team wins; AI and direct commands work.
evidence: game/tests/m4_smoke.gd: M4_SMOKE_OK (three recruit paths, decline and revisit, level matching, five slots, switching, pause, quick skill, AI policy, temporary order, full-auto win, downed recovery)

steps.title: Levels and jobs
steps.summary: Individual XP/JP, four aptitudes, four two-stage job series, mandatory ten-level choices, saved progress and JP ranks for job and personal skills.
steps.acceptance: Stay, promote and switch jobs; return with prior progress; 25% reserve rewards.
evidence: game/tests/m5_smoke.gd: M5_SMOKE_OK (level 10 gate, stay, promote, switch and return, job and personal JP upgrades, aptitude costs and gates, reserve quarter rewards, combat job skill and battle-to-growth routing)

steps.title: Saves and recovery
steps.summary: Three manual slots, five rolling autosaves, prebattle checkpoints, victory records, versioned disk saves and full game-state recovery.
steps.acceptance: Restart and load key states; loss returns to menu with load available.
evidence: game/tests/m6_smoke.gd: M6_SMOKE_OK (manual slots, area/map position, party, jobs, AI, recruitment, enemies, five autosaves, defeat checkpoint, victory save, pending job choice, old-version rejection)
game/tests/m6_restart_smoke.gd: M6_RESTART_OK (fresh Godot process reads disk save and restores scene)

steps.title: Playable content
steps.summary: Three freely ordered destinations now include six survey rooms, eighteen bilingual clues, three retryable evidence questions, recruit options, machine choice, a field log, and a report endpoint. Timed playthrough remains outstanding.
steps.acceptance: Finish without developer tools in a 25–35 minute route; two exploration/recruit orders; both languages fit.
details: 三处地点可自由选择顺序；梁序、赵铃、纪澄仍可暂不邀请并回访。
城市档案馆、城外中继区与遗址各有外层和内层，共六处勘察空间、18 条中英文线索与三道可重试研判题。
完成每处研判仅奖励一次 JP；线索、结果、所在房间与位置可保存并恢复。
实地日志显示勘察进度与本次用时；完成汇报后仍可自由探索。
remaining: 从新档进行真实计时试玩，确认是否达到 25–35 分钟且内容不靠等待填充。
按实际试玩结果补足内容或调整节奏，并修复发现的操作或文本问题。
evidence: game/tests/m7_smoke.gd: M7_SMOKE_OK (two destination orders, all three surveys, wrong-answer retry, one-time JP reward, annex save/load, report endpoint)

steps.title: Acceptance and tuning
steps.summary: Full playthroughs, transition timing, usability findings, blocker fixes.
steps.acceptance: Two fresh playthroughs without blockers; save/recruit revisit verified.
